public.text: The Benefits Package Registry uses the Facility Registry for provider empanelment. Facility identity and capability support empanelment, but contractual participation and scheme status belong elsewhere.
public.suggestedRevision: State that the Facility Registry supplies authoritative facility identity and service attributes, while empanelment and contracting are managed by financing or contract-management systems.
